title: Round 63 (F369): Tile-lib anomaly survey - 147 unbound maps carry libs outside EI binding range (200-254 anim markers, forest 42-55, snow 56-69) + zero bound maps use them + EI playable set = 211 maps using ONLY base/wood/sand libs + Forest/Snow subdirs are other-client artifacts
objective: Resolve the tile-lib anomaly: maps referencing libs 200-254, forest (42-55), and snow (56-69) - determine whether they are playable EI maps or legacy/other-version artifacts, and bound the EI 3.0 playable map set's lib usage.
question: Which maps reference libs outside the EI client's binding range (base 0-13 / wood 14-27 / sand 28-41), and are any of them in the playable (server-bound) set?
method: Full 544-map scan for lib ids in ranges {200-254, 42-55 forest, 56-69 snow, 14-27 wood, 28-41 sand, 0-13 base}; cross-reference against server MiniMap.txt (313 entries, 211 matching EI maps); cell-level img-value inspection; mapviewer render/cell verification.

lib_range_usage.200-254: 39 maps (0 bound - ALL unbound legacy; 255 = empty sentinel excluded)

anomaly_maps.tile_row: ALL row=0 (header[0x14]=0) - client binds ids 14-27 only, forest/snow/anomaly libs OUT OF RANGE
anomaly_maps.img_values: cell img values near 0xFF00 (65305/65348 = 0xFF19/0xFF44) - non-EI tile encoding (animation markers or other-version format)
anomaly_maps.render: mapviewer resolves lib255/empty; cells with lib 200+ render black/missing

ei_playable_set.lib_usage: ZERO bound maps use libs 200-254, forest 42-55, or snow 56-69 - playable maps use ONLY base/wood/sand
ei_playable_set.conclusion: EI 3.0 playable map set = 211 maps; libs {0-13, 14-27, 28-41} only

subdir_verdict.Data/Forest: exists but NO EI map references forest libs - other-client (Zircon KR) artifact
subdir_verdict.Data/Snow: exists but NO EI map references snow libs - other-client artifact

audit_vs_exe.F343: binding formula (row+1)*14 confirmed; forest/snow/anomaly libs outside bound range
audit_vs_exe.F342: 544-map inventory refined: only 211 playable, 333 on-disk extras (147 with out-of-range libs + 186 clean unused)
audit_vs_exe.F310: 211 MiniMap.txt bindings confirmed as the playable set

contrast.bound_vs_unbound: bound (211): base+wood/sand libs only, render correctly; unbound (333): include 147 with forest/snow/200+ libs that render black if ever loaded
contrast.wood_vs_forest_vs_snow: wood = EI 3.0 default terrain; forest/snow = other-client terrains (subdirs exist but unused by EI maps)

verdict: Tile-lib anomaly resolved (primary-bytes): the EI 3.0 playable map set = 211 server-bound maps using ONLY libs {0-13 base, 14-27 wood, 28-41 sand}. The 147 maps referencing libs 200-254 / forest 42-55 / snow 56-69 are ALL unbound legacy/other-version artifacts (kt* Korean test, d*/D6xx dungeons, 0_0031-33); their libs fall outside the client's tile-row binding range and would render black/missing. Data/Forest + Data/Snow subdirs are other-client artifacts, not used by EI 3.0.
evidence_level_note: Lib ranges, tile-row bytes and img values read directly from all 544 map files; server binding via MiniMap.txt; mapviewer render verified.
tool: python3 struct scan; mapviewer HTTP; curl
reproduce: scan all 544 maps for lib ids in ranges (see scripts above); cross-ref MiniMap.txt; curl /tile + /api/cell on 0_0031.map
notes: 255 = empty-layer sentinel (not anomaly); excluded from 200+ counts
0_0031/32/33 (18x22) heavy lib-207/227 usage with img ~0xFF00 - possibly cutscene/anim maps for another build
mapviewer emits 'lib255' fallback naming for unmapped libs (correct defensive behavior)
